USAGE:
    agentpack [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    agentpack list skills --group backend
    agentpack find typescript --kind skills
    agentpack groups
    agentpack init
    agentpack init --overlay

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    list                List catalog assets, filterable by kind, group, and     
                        provider                                                
    find <query>        Search the approved catalog by id, name, description,   
                        kind, or group                                          
    groups              List catalog groups                                     
    init                Initialize a standalone or project-local asset catalog  
    new <kind> <id>     Scaffold a new local asset (manifest + content) ready   
                        for a PR                                                
    import <url>        Scaffold an external asset pinned to an upstream commit 
                        or tag                                                  
    add                 Install assets. With no arguments, pick interactively   
    remove <targets>    Remove installed assets, including their entries in     
                        shared provider configs                                 
    upgrade             Upgrade installed assets to the catalog versions        
    outdated            Show installed assets with newer catalog versions       
    plan                Dry-run of add: show what would be installed where      
    status              Show installed assets and their state                   
    diff <id>           Compare an installed asset against its lockfile checksum
    pin <id>            Pin an installed asset so upgrades skip it              
    unpin <id>          Unpin an installed asset                                
    doctor              Show environment, detected providers, catalog, and

DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a new local asset (manifest + content) ready for a PR

USAGE:
    agentpack new <kind> <id> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentpack new skills grill-me --group review

ARGUMENTS:
    <kind>    Asset kind: skills, hooks, mcp, tools, instructions, rules,       
              prompts, templates, agents                                        
    <id>      Kebab-case asset id — also the folder name                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
        --name <NAME>                                                           
        --description <TEXT>                                                    
    -g, --group <GROUP>          Groups this asset belongs to (repeatable or    
                                 comma-separated)                               
    -p, --provider <PROVIDER>    Limit to specific providers. Omit for all      
                                 providers (the default)                        
        --owner <TEAM>           Owning team (optional — CODEOWNERS usually     
                                 covers this)                                   
        --force                  Overwrite an existing manifest                 
        --overlay                Create the asset in .agentpack/assets for this 
                                 project or service team

DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold an external asset pinned to an upstream commit or tag

USAGE:
    agentpack import <url> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentpack import https://github.com/acme/skills/.../pdf@<commit-sha>

ARGUMENTS:
    <url>    Upstream URL, ideally with the pinned ref:                         
             https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/main/path@<commit-sha>          

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
        --ref <REF>              Reviewed commit SHA or immutable tag           
                                 (alternative to the @ref suffix)               
        --kind <KIND>            Asset kind. Default: skills                    
        --id <ID>                Asset id. Default: last URL path segment       
    -g, --group <GROUP>                                                         
    -p, --provider <PROVIDER>    Limit to specific providers. Omit for all      
                                 providers (the default)                        
        --license <LICENSE>      Upstream license (e.g. MIT). Recorded for      
                                 compliance                                     
        --force

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install assets. With no arguments, pick interactively

USAGE:
    agentpack add [targets] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentpack add
    agentpack add grill-me secret-scan --claude

ARGUMENTS:
    [targets]    Optional kind (skills, hooks, mcp, ...) followed by asset ids. 
                 Empty = interactive selection                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
        --user                   Operate on user scope (your home directory)    
                                 instead of the project                         
        --project                Operate on project scope (the current          
                                 repository)                                    
        --claude                 Target Claude Code                             
        --codex                  Target Codex                                   
        --copilot                Target GitHub Copilot                          
        --cursor                 Target Cursor                                  
    -p, --provider <PROVIDER>    Target providers by name (repeatable or        
                                 comma-separated)                               
    -y, --yes                    Skip confirmation prompts (for scripts and CI) 
        --force                  Overwrite locally modified installs without    
                                 asking                                         
        --keep-local             Keep locally modified installs without asking  
    -g, --group <GROUP>          Install everything in a group (repeatable or   
                                 comma-separated)
